name: adsterra-ad-monorepo
description: Framework-agnostic ad components with React, Vue, and Svelte adapters.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/core && npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/react && npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/vue && npm run build -w @adsterra-ad/svelte
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/core && npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/react && npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/vue && npm run typecheck -w @adsterra-ad/svelte
